{{Current events|year=2018|month=11|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Nissan]] chairman and former CEO [[Carlos Ghosn]] is arrested in [[Japan]] for breaching the country's financial trading laws, prompting Nissan to recommend that he and director Greg Kelly step down for misconduct. Ghosn is also the chairman and CEO of [[Renault]]. [https://www.irishtimes.com/business/manufacturing/nissan-accuses-chairman-carlos-ghosn-of-misconduct-1.3702809 (''The Irish Times'')]
*The {{convert|930|km|adj=on}} offshore section of the [[TurkStream]] gas pipeline, between [[Russia]] and [[Turkey]], is completed. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-11-19/putin-s-gas-link-to-make-landfall-in-turkey-amid-u-s-opposition (Bloomberg)]
*[[David's Bridal]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2018/11/19/davids-bridal-bankruptcy/2053083002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Vietnam floods]]
**Landslides due to rains from a tropical storm have killed 13 people and left four others missing in south-central [[Vietnam]]. [https://m.news24.com/World/News/landslides-kill-13-leave-4-missing-in-south-central-vietnam-20181119 (News24)]

;International relations
*[[President of the Maldives]] [[Ibrahim Mohamed Solih]] and his Cabinet announce that the [[Maldives]] is set to return to be a member of the [[Commonwealth of Nations]]. [https://www.timesnownews.com/international/article/maldives-all-set-to-rejoin-commonwealth-of-nations/317623 (Times Now)]

;Law and crime
*[[Watts family homicides]]
**Chris Watts of [[Frederick, Colorado]], is sentenced to three consecutive terms of life in prison without the possibility of parole for killing his pregnant wife Shanann and their two young daughters. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/chris-watts-sentencing-hearing-in-killings-of-young-daughters-pregnant-wife-shanann-watts-live-updates-today-2018-11-19/ (CBS News)]
*[[Mercy Hospital shooting]]
** A shooting takes place at [[Mercy Hospital and Medical Center|Mercy Hospital]] in [[Chicago]], leaving four dead, including the gunman. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/multiple-victims-injured-shooting-chicago-hospital-police/story?id=59301252 (ABC)]
*''[[CNN v. Trump]]''
**[[CNN]] drops its lawsuit against the [[Presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] after the White House restores reporter [[Jim Acosta]]'s press pass. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/cnn-drops-suit-against-white-house-after-acostas-press-pass-is-fully-restored/2018/11/19/519763fc-ec3a-11e8-8679-934a2b33be52_story.html?utm_term=.74c2bd78de6e (''The Washington Post'')]
**The White House also issues a set of four guidelines reporters must follow at press conferences to avoid further press pass revocations. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/white-house-jim-acostas-press-pass-cnn-seeks/story?id=59291734 (ABC News)]
*[[List of executive actions by Donald Trump]]
**A federal judge blocks an order by President Trump that denies asylum to illegal immigrants. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2018/11/20/blow-trumps-immigration-agenda-federal-judge-blocks-asylum-ban-migrants-who-enter-illegally-mexico/?utm_term=.85d0b52b2295 (''The Washington Post'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Exploration of Mars]]
**[[NASA]] selects [[Jezero (crater)|Jezero]] crater on [[Mars]] as the landing site for the [[Mars 2020]] [[Mars rover|rover]]. The crater was once a large [[lake]] and may hold evidence of [[astrobiology|ancient life]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46264383 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 NFL season]]
**The [[Los Angeles Rams]] defeat the [[Kansas City Chiefs]] 54–51 on [[Monday Night Football]] in the [[List of highest scoring NFL games|third-highest scoring NFL game]] in history. [https://amp.theguardian.com/sport/2018/nov/20/la-rams-kansas-city-chiefs-score-monday-night-football (The Guardian)]
